title.text: Budapest: Guided City Centre Electric Bike Tour

pills.label: 3.5 hours
pills.pop_html: Duration: 3.5 hours.

pills.label: 3 languages
pills.pop_html: Live guide in English, German and French.

pills.summary_html: ⚡ E-bike up Castle Hill▾
pills.pop_html: The climb: After the Chain Bridge, now closed to private cars, the route climbs Castle Hill to Matthias Church and Fisherman's Bastion with electric support. You still pedal: the bikes are wooden-frame my-esel or KTM Cento e-bikes.

pills.summary_html: 📍 19 stops, both banks▾
pills.pop_html: Route: Jewish Quarter, House of Terror, Heroes' Square, City Park and Vajdahunyad Castle, Andrássy Avenue, the Opera, St Stephen's Basilica, Parliament, Castle Hill, Rudas and Gellért Baths, Liberty Bridge, Central Market Hall, the National Museum and Dohány Street Synagogue. All seen from outside, no entries.
Group: Shared departures are capped at 10 participants, and the same route can be booked as a private tour. Guides speak English, German and French.
Who can ride: Not suitable for children under 13, riders under 160 cm or over 110 kg, or anyone without cycling experience. Helmets are provided but optional.

pills.label: What's included
pills.pop_html: Included: E-bike rental; Tour guide; Helmet (optional).Not included: Hotel pick-up and drop-off; Tips; Food and drinks.

best_for.pick_html: for first-timers who want Buda and Pest in one ride without sweating up Castle Hill, because the motor handles the climb and the loop covers 19 stops in 3.5 hours.
best_for.skip_html: if you are under 160 cm, over 110 kg or have never ridden a bike in traffic: the Segway tours at #4 and #6 have looser limits.

items.a: Bike & Relax, Madách Imre út 12, 1075 Budapest.
Under 13, under 160 cm, over 110 kg, no cycling experience.

price.note: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before. The final price shows before you pay.

pills.label: English guide
pills.pop_html: Live guide in English.

pills.label: 12+ only
pills.pop_html: 🎟️ Kids: ✕ not suitable for children under 12⚠️ Not suitable for: pregnant women

pills.summary_html: 🏰 Castle Hill + Margaret Island▾
pills.pop_html: Buda side: Ride Duna Corso to Elizabeth Bridge, climb the Castle District for a 25-minute stop with free time and the Fisherman's Bastion view, then drop to Margaret Bridge for a 20-minute break on Margaret Island.
Included: Bike, helmet, live guide, a bottle of mineral water, sunscreen and a clean toilet at the start office. Tips are extra.
Same route: The same route and timetable is also sold as an e-bike tour from the same meeting point, for €50. The €12 difference buys electric help on the Castle Hill climb.

pills.summary_html: 🕒 Andrássy if time permits▾
pills.pop_html: Pest finale: After Parliament, Liberty Square and St Stephen's Basilica, the ride continues down Andrássy Avenue past the Opera and House of Terror to Heroes' Square and City Park only if time permits. Those stops are marked optional.

pills.label: What's included
pills.pop_html: Included: Bike; Live guide; A bottle of mineral water; Helmet; Sunscreen.Not included: Tips.

best_for.pick_html: for riders happy to pedal who want Castle Hill and Margaret Island, because €12.67 an hour is the lowest price per hour of any tour here that guarantees the Buda climb.
best_for.skip_html: if pedalling uphill puts you off: Castle Hill is a real climb on a classic bike, so take #1 or the €50 e-bike version of this route.

items.a: Bike, helmet, live guide, bottle of mineral water, sunscreen, clean toilet.

price.note: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before. The final price shows before you pay.

pills.label: 1–4 hours
pills.pop_html: Duration: 1–4 hours.

pills.label: English guide
pills.pop_html: Live guide in English.

The vehicle: MonsteRollers have 9.5-inch-wide wheels, a low platform and a top speed of 25 km/h. No driving licence needed, though bike or scooter experience is recommended. Every tour starts with a short training and practice session.

Routes: Choose an express highlights ride, a themed tour, a long Buda, Pest and Margaret Island loop or a half-day option with food tastings. Optional stops include Buda Castle, Fisherman's Bastion, Citadella on Gellért Hill and Margaret Island, so check which your route covers.
Group: Small-group departures are capped at 8 to 10 riders and larger parties are split; bigger groups can book privately.

Age rules: Drivers must be 14 or older. Kids aged 10 to 18 can ride on the back seat of a double-seater if you request it when booking, and every participant pays. No high heels; skirts are not advised.

pills.label: What's included
pills.pop_html: Included: Use of MonsteRoller electric scooter; Local professional tour guide; Helmet; Rain poncho and warm gloves (when needed).Not included: Hotel pick-up and drop-off; Personal travel insurance; Tips.

best_for.pick_html: for anyone who wants the hills without pedalling, because the route menu runs from a short express ride to a 4-hour loop and is the only one here listing the Citadella on Gellért Hill.
best_for.skip_html: if you are unsure you can ride: if you cannot handle the MonsteRoller after the practice session, there is no refund.

items.a: MonsteRoller e-scooter, local tour guide, helmet, rain poncho and warm gloves when needed.
Under 14 (as driver), pregnant women, people with mobility impairments.
Small groups up to 8 to 10, private on request.

pills.label: 2.5 hours
pills.pop_html: Duration: 2.5 hours.

pills.label: 6 languages
pills.pop_html: Live guide in English, Russian, Kazakh, French, Spanish and German.

pills.summary_html: 🏰 Up to Matthias Church▾
pills.pop_html: Buda half: Over Elizabeth Bridge to the St Gerard statue, Castle Garden Bazaar and Adam Clark Square, then up past Buda Castle to Fisherman's Bastion and a 10-minute break at Matthias Church.
Pest half: Back over the Chain Bridge to the Shoes on the Danube Bank, a Parliament photo stop, Liberty Square and St Stephen's Basilica before returning to Galamb utca.
Included: Safety training and a supervised test drive, all equipment, photos of your tour, coffee and water, rain ponchos and winter gloves. Tips optional.
Who can ride: Riders must weigh between 30 and 140 kg, and under-16s ride with an adult. Pregnant women cannot join. In heavy rain (more than 1 mm per hour) the tour can be rescheduled.

pills.label: What's included
pills.pop_html: Included: Live Guiding; Safety training and supervised test drive; All necessary equipment; Photos of your tour; Coffee and water.Not included: Tips (optional).

pills.label: Private option
pills.pop_html: Private or small groups available.

best_for.pick_html: for a both-banks overview with zero pedalling, because it is the only Segway tour here that climbs to Matthias Church and still covers Parliament and the Basilica.
best_for.skip_html: if price per hour matters most: at €27.60 an hour it costs nearly double the e-bike at #1.

items.a: Live guiding, safety training and supervised test drive, all equipment, photos of your tour, coffee and water, rain ponchos, winter gloves.
Pregnant women, people over 140 kg or under 30 kg.
English, Russian, Kazakh, French, Spanish, German.

pills.summary_html: 🏰 20 min at Fisherman's Bastion▾
pills.pop_html: Route: Elizabeth Bridge, Buda Castle, a 20-minute break with free time at Fisherman's Bastion, then Chain Bridge, St Stephen's Basilica, Liberty Square, Parliament and the Shoes on the Danube Bank. The option you book makes it shorter or longer.

pills.summary_html: 🧒 15+ solo, kids ride behind▾
pills.pop_html: Age rules: Riders under 15 cannot drive alone but can ride behind an adult. Maximum weight 136 kg; pregnant women cannot join.
Included: Briefing and supervised test ride, a helmet in all sizes, rain poncho and cold-season gloves, plus coffee or tea in the office. Tips optional.
Languages: Shared tours run in English, Spanish and Russian; private tours can be guided in another language.

pills.label: What's included
pills.pop_html: Included: Monster bike ride; Live guide; Briefing and supervised test ride; Helmet (all sizes); Rain poncho (if needed).Not included: Tips (optional).

pills.label: Private option
pills.pop_html: Private or small groups available.

best_for.pick_html: for couples and families with teens who want Castle Hill on wheels with the best guest score on the page (4.96 out of 5), because the route builds in 20 minutes of free time at Fisherman's Bastion.
best_for.skip_html: if you want to choose your stops: the route is fixed and only its length changes with the option, so pick #3 for a route menu.

items.a: Monster bike ride, live guide, briefing and supervised test ride, helmet (all sizes), rain poncho, cold-season gloves, coffee or tea in the office.
Under 15 as driver, pregnant women, over 136 kg.

Format: Sold as a private tour: your guide rides only with your party, and you pick from multiple start times through the day.

Who can ride: Children from 8 who weigh at least 30 kg. Bring a passport or ID card (a copy is accepted). Guides speak 7 languages, including Arabic and Hungarian.

best_for.pick_html: for a first-afternoon orientation or a nervous first-time rider, because it is private, starts with a 15-minute training session and is over in 90 minutes for €45.
best_for.skip_html: if you want Buda: the route stays on the Pest side, so take #4 for Matthias Church.

pills.label: 3.5 hours
pills.pop_html: Duration: 3.5 hours.

pills.label: English guide
pills.pop_html: Live guide in English.
Value: 3.5 hours for €36 is the lowest hourly price on this page. Bike, helmet, a refreshment and an English-speaking guide are included.

Route: Andrássy Avenue, Elizabeth Square, Vajdahunyad Castle, City Park, Széchenyi Thermal Bath, Heroes' Square, House of Music, Parliament, St Stephen's Basilica, Chain Bridge, Liberty Square, Castle Garden Bazaar and Elizabeth Bridge. Castle Hill is a pass-by, not a climb.
Option: Book an e-bike as an extra if you want electric help. The ride is in English and starts in all weather.
Who can ride: Minimum age 12. You need to ride safely and confidently in city traffic and keep an easy pace with the group.

pills.label: What's included
pills.pop_html: Included: Bicycle or e-bike; Helmet; Refreshment; Local English-speaking guide.

best_for.pick_html: for budget travellers who want the longest guided ride for the money, because €36 buys 3.5 hours, 15 stops and a refreshment.
best_for.skip_html: if Fisherman's Bastion is the point: this route passes Castle Hill without climbing it, so take #2.

items.a: Bicycle or e-bike, helmet, refreshment, local English-speaking guide.
Children under 12, people who cannot ride a bike.

title.text: Budapest: Guided City Discovery Bike Tour

pills.label: 2.5 hours
pills.pop_html: Duration: 2.5 hours.

pills.summary_html: 🌳 Flat, on bike lanes▾
pills.pop_html: Terrain: Pest only, mostly on cycle lanes: Liberty Square, Shoes on the Danube Bank, Parliament, Andrássy Avenue, Heroes' Square, a walk into City Park and Vajdahunyad Castle, Széchenyi Thermal Bath and the Zoo.
Languages: One of two bike tours here with guides beyond English. The route passes Nagymező utca, the theatre and bar street, and guides share night-out tips there.
Who can ride: Not suitable under 8, the lowest bike age on this page. No strollers, luggage or large bags.
Finish: Starts at Szent István tér 4 by St Stephen's Basilica and returns through the old streets past the Dohány Street Synagogue, with 3 drop-off locations.

pills.label: What's included
pills.pop_html: Included: Personal guide; Bike; Helmet.

best_for.pick_html: for families with kids aged 8 to 12 and anyone who wants a flat, low-stress ride, because it sticks to Pest bike lanes and costs €33.
best_for.skip_html: if you want Buda views from the top: it never climbs to the Castle District.

price.note: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before. The final price shows before you pay.
